hypothesis: A causally confirmed fixed range may supply lower-edge rotation opportunities outside the K/S trend clusters; incremental coverage and economics are unmeasured.

source.author: Al Brooks / Brooks Trading Course
source.original_market_tf: General price-action glossary; examples include E-mini/QQQ and intraday charts, not a crypto30m strategy.

rules.formation: At a completed30m bar use this and previous11 contiguous timely bars. L=min(low),H=max(high),W=H-L>0. Lower tests low<=L+0.1W; upper tests high>=H-0.1W. Each edge needs2 tests with index separation>=3. Test sequences interleave: last low-test after first high-test AND last high-test after first low-test. Each test candle must not reach both edge zones. Freeze L/H at formation close; never roll them during setup.
rules.entry: On one of the next6 contiguous timely completed bars, require L<=low<=L+0.2W, high<=H, close>open, close>prior close, L+0.25W<=close<L+0.5W. Signal at close only; engine enters immediate next UTC open. Lower breach is forbidden; this is not failed-breakout recovery.
rules.entry_gap: Reject actual entry<=L or entry>=center. No hindsight and no stop fallback.
rules.initial_stop: Resting stop at frozen L. Existing engine chooses adverse open on gap stop and stop before any target/callback.
rules.profit_exit: Completed close>=frozen(L+H)/2 queues next-open exit. Intrabar center touch without close confirmation is not a fill.
rules.time_exit: Existing engine max_hold8 completed bars queues next-open exit; no forced final-price close.
rules.reentry: One emitted signal per frozen box, regardless of later fill rejection. After signal, expiry or any outside-range high/low, require12 entirely new bars before another box. No retune.
rules.gaps: Missing/segment-break or available_ts>close_ts resets formation/setup; existing open-position engine retains unresolved ownership across missing bars.
rules.same_bar: Stop first; only after no stop does callback inspect completed close; target and time exits occur next open.

input_contract.time_basis: UTC30m complete consecutive bars; historical available_ts=close model; no observed latency claim

costs: Unmodified scalp7_execution_v2 and pinned SCALP7_CURRENT_REFERENCE_COST_SNAPSHOT_V2; cost1x/2x same fills; reference funding reserve, not actual historical funding. No own acceptance threshold.
prior_difference: Versus range_fade__donor_state_machine_v2 (5m EMA-flat rolling20 breach/reclaim, ATR stop,VWAP50 target) and bb_revert__donor_state_machine_v2 (BB20 extension/reentry,ATR stop,rolling mean target), use30m two-sided multi-tested fixed box, strictly in-range rejection without breach, box-floor stop and frozen center-close exit; no EMA/ATR/BB/VWAP.
direction: LONG_ONLY_NEW_RESEARCH_IDENTITY; existing K/S directions unchanged; no order authority expanded.
freeze_order: This file was written before adapter.py and test_adapter.py; no actual-price evaluation or parameter selection.
